forms.integer: Write a whole number, without commas.
forms.range: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
forms.timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
forms.invalid: Check the highlighted fields, then try again.
forms.saveFailed: I cannot save the configuration. Try again in a moment.

siteName.label: Site name
siteName.help: Shown on the images and on the night pages.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.help: Positive north of the equator, negative south.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.help: Positive east of Greenwich, negative west.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Used for the time on the images and for sunrise and sunset.

folder.label: Save folder
folder.help: Frames, timelapses and keograms go here.

keepNights.label: Nights to keep
keepNights.help: Nights older than this number are deleted.

timelapse.label: Timelapse
timelapse.help: A video that runs through the whole night.

keogram.label: Keogram
keogram.help: A strip showing how the sky changes during the night.

startrails.label: Startrails
startrails.help: An image with the star trails of the whole night.

location.help: The app does not send the location to any server: it only uses it to fill in the fields.
location.done: Location read. Check the values before you continue.
location.unsupported: This browser cannot read the location. Enter the values by hand.
location.error: I cannot read the location. Enter the values by hand, or allow location access and try again.

cameras.empty: I cannot find any camera. Connect the USB camera or start the ASCOM simulator, then try again.
cameras.failed: I cannot connect the camera. Check that it is on, then try again.
cameras.previewEmpty: No image yet. If the first one does not arrive, check that the camera is connected.

camera.title: Choose the camera
camera.lede: Connect the camera and choose the one to use. After it connects, you will see the sky below.

site.title: Where the observatory is
site.lede: These are needed to calculate the Sun and the twilight times.

archive.title: Folder and archive
archive.lede: Where to save the images and how long to keep them.

wizard.skipHelp: Does not save your changes. You can run the setup again from the Site page.

camera.title: Camera
camera.lede: Choose the camera and set how it captures.

gain.label: Gain
gain.help: Higher means more sensitivity and more noise.

maxExposure.label: Maximum night exposure
maxExposure.help: Longer exposures show fainter stars, but the trails get longer.

dayExposure.label: Day exposure
dayExposure.help: Length of one day exposure, when the sky is very bright.

binning.label: Binning
binning.help: Combines pixels: less detail, more sensitivity, smaller files.

dayCapture.label: Capture during the day
dayCapture.help: Saves frames even with the Sun up. If off, nothing is saved by day.

site.title: Site
site.lede: Location, language, theme, network and archive.

language.label: Language
language.help: Changes the interface at once. Saved with Save.

theme.label: Theme
theme.help: The theme changes at once, so you can see it before saving.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.help: Light by day, dark by night.

red.label: Red
red.help: Only reds on black: keeps your night vision.

port.label: Port
port.help: Port the engine answers on. After changing it, restart the engine.

lan.label: Allow access from the local network
lan.help: Other devices on the network will be able to open this page.
lan.warning: A password is needed to protect access. The field will arrive in a later version: until then, turn this on only on networks you trust.

enabled.label: Show text
enabled.help: A text box over the frames.

label.label: Label
label.help: Fixed text, for example the club name. Up to 40 characters.
